basic_info.description: $100k Price Reduction! Experience elevated living in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom luxury condominium, masterfully designed by renowned Bay Area architect Stanley Saitowitz. This sun-drenched home, situated on the desirable corner of the building, offers breathtaking views of downtown San Francisco, the Bay Bridge, and the Mission District, framed by large windows that flood the space with natural light. Step into a world of elegance with a modern aesthetic that features 9' high ceilings, recessed lighting, distinctive hardwood floors, and double-pane windows fitted with motorized, custom Hunter Douglas shades. The open-concept living area is complemented by a chef's dream gourmet kitchen, complete with a Bosch refrigerator, Bertazzoni gas range, integrated dishwasher, and a spacious, custom island perfect for entertaining. Both bedrooms are equipped with custom closet organizers, while the entire home benefits from air conditioning and an in-unit Bosch washer and dryer for added convenience. The building has a huge roof deck with panoramic views. Parking with personal E/V charger, deeded storage, & bike storage. Located in the vibrant Mission district, with a walk Score of 99, Bike Score of 98, and Transit Score of 100 the location is truly the epitome of convenience.
